_nguon: Stage 4.2 English overlay — Planets × 12 Zodiac Signs.

bach_duong.tom_tat: Aries expresses direct initiative, candid candor, and quick readiness to begin.

kim_nguu.tom_tat: Taurus expresses steady accumulation, tangible craft, and unhurried reliability.

song_tu.tom_tat: Gemini expresses curious inquiry, agile dialogue, and multi-threaded learning.

cu_giai.tom_tat: Cancer expresses protective care, emotional memory, and devotion to safe belonging.

su_tu.tom_tat: Leo expresses warm self-direction, generous presence, and wholehearted expression.

xu_nu.tom_tat: Virgo expresses discerning refinement, practical service, and clean organization.

thien_binh.tom_tat: Libra expresses fair-minded mediation, relational poise, and balanced proportion.

bo_cap.tom_tat: Scorpio expresses focused intensity, root-cause honesty, and deep loyalty.

nhan_ma.tom_tat: Sagittarius expresses broad horizon-seeking, candid synthesis, and love of exploration.

ma_ket.tom_tat: Capricorn expresses long-horizon discipline, structural accountability, and earned mastery.

bao_binh.tom_tat: Aquarius expresses independent systems thinking, principled reform, and civic perspective.

song_ngu.tom_tat: Pisces expresses receptive empathy, imaginative synthesis, and quiet compassion.

mat_troi.vai_tro: core conscious identity and vital direction

bach_duong.diem_sang: You feel most alive when you start something new and make your own call; you bounce back fast and dare to go first.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You can rush, then drop things once the thrill fades; others may feel you push past them.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Before diving into something new, write three concrete steps and name one person who will see it through with you.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You feel most confident building things that last: savings, solid skills, a steady routine; you keep your word and stay patient.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: You can be stubborn and resist change even when the old way no longer fits; you may hold on to things and habits.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Each month, make one deliberate small change (a new method, a different spend) so steady does not turn rigid.

song_tu.diem_sang: You light up when you learn, ask, talk and connect people; your mind is quick and adaptable.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You can take on too much at once and spread thin, talking more than doing; others may find you inconsistent.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Pick one subject to study in depth for three months and note what you got done each week.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You are strongest when you care for the people close to you and build a safe place; you sense others' feelings and remember kindness.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: You can take things personally and withdraw when hurt; sometimes you care for others and forget to state your own needs.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: When upset, say one plain sentence starting with 'I need…' instead of waiting for others to guess.

su_tu.diem_sang: You shine when you create, lead and are recognised; generous, warm and inspiring.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You can feel slighted when overlooked and want the spotlight; feedback may be hard to take.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Find one thing you are proud of doing without anyone's praise, and leave room for others to shine too.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You are at your best organising, improving and being genuinely useful; careful, practical and dedicated.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You can be hard on yourself and others, fret over small details and rarely feel satisfied.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Set a 'good enough' bar before each task and stop when you reach it; note one thing you did well each day.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You are strong at balancing sides, building harmony and beauty; fair, courteous and good at teamwork.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You can hesitate and delay decisions to avoid upsetting anyone; sometimes you accommodate too much.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Give small decisions a short deadline; practise saying 'no' gently.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You are strong when you see something through and look beneath the surface; determined, deep and loyal.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You can hold things inside, grow suspicious and find it hard to let go; you may want control.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Choose one trusted person to tell what you have been holding in; let go of one thing that does not need your control.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You feel most alive travelling, learning big ideas and seeking meaning; optimistic, frank and generous.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You can over-promise and dodge details or long commitments; your bluntness may hurt.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Turn one big wish into a plan with real dates; before speaking bluntly, think how the listener will take it.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You are strong at setting long-term goals and climbing step by step; disciplined, responsible and reliable.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You can overwork, be strict with yourself and hide your feelings; you may measure your worth by results.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Schedule fixed rest time alongside work; each week do one thing purely for fun.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You are strong at thinking differently, improving how things work and serving the common good; independent, open to the new, loyal to friends.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You can seem distant, hold tightly to your views and shy away from emotional closeness.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Test a new idea right away with a real group; ask loved ones how they feel, not only what they think.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You are strong in imagination and compassion; intuitive, artistic and kind-hearted.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You can drift, avoid hard facts and get swept along by others; boundaries are hard to set.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Keep one regular activity with clear hours; write down your limits before agreeing to help someone.

mat_trang.vai_tro: instinctive emotional rhythm, habit patterns, and inner safety

bach_duong.diem_sang: You need freedom and quick responses; feelings flare up and pass fast, and you say what you see.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: Waiting irritates you, and when annoyed you may speak before thinking.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: When annoyed, move for ten minutes (a walk, the stairs) before you reply.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You feel settled with familiar routines, good food and a comfortable home; your moods are steady.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Sudden change unsettles you for a long time; you may seek comfort in food or shopping.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Keep a small evening ritual (tea, music, tidying your sleep corner) to calm down instead of shopping.

song_tu.diem_sang: You calm down by talking, reading and understanding what is going on; your feelings are flexible.
song_tu.nen_de_y: You may analyse feelings instead of feeling them; your mind finds it hard to rest.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Write three lines each night: what happened, how you felt, what you need.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You need a sense of family, to be sheltered and to shelter others; warm-hearted with a long memory.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Your mood rises and falls with the atmosphere at home; careless words hurt.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: Make one corner of home truly comfortable; when someone hurts you, ask what they meant instead of guessing.

su_tu.diem_sang: You need love shown clearly and to feel valued; when happy you are warm and big-hearted.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may feel hurt when ignored and need praise to feel okay.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Acknowledge yourself for one thing each day; tell loved ones what kind of attention you hope for.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You feel settled when things are in order and you can be useful; you show love through practical help.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: You can worry, blame yourself and feel tense when things are messy.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: When worried, list what is in your hands and do the smallest item right away.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You need harmony and company; you are most at ease when relationships are smooth.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: You may swallow irritation to keep the peace, then feel drained without saying why.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Practise stating what bothers you in one gentle sentence the same day, instead of letting it pile up.

bo_cap.diem_sang: Your feelings run deep and strong; you need trust and sincere closeness.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: You may feel jealous, hold on to the past and find it hard to open up before you fully trust.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Write down what is weighing on you and sleep on it before acting; share it bit by bit with someone you trust.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You need space and new experiences to feel happy; optimistic and quick to bounce back.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: You may dodge heavy feelings by going out or keeping busy; sitting with sadness is hard.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: When something sad happens, set aside one session just to think it through before looking for something new.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You feel settled when things are under control and responsibilities are clear; steady and rarely complaining.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: You may hide feelings, carry everything alone and avoid asking for help.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Each week, ask someone for one small favour, and share one real feeling with a loved one.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You need freedom and to be yourself; you value friends and stay calm in a storm.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You may detach from feelings, and loved ones may find you cool or distant.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: See loved ones in person more often; when they are sad, ask 'do you want me to listen or to advise?'.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You sense things finely, empathise easily and need quiet time and your own inner world.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: You may absorb other people's feelings as your own and feel drained without knowing why; you may escape.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: After seeing many people, give yourself quiet time; practise asking 'is this feeling mine or theirs?'.

thuy_tinh.vai_tro: information processing, reasoning style, and everyday communication

bach_duong.diem_sang: You grasp core points rapidly, speak straight to the issue, and ask direct questions when discussions drift.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You can interrupt slower speakers or jump to conclusions halfway through a briefing, and quick messages may sound abrupt.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Pause for three quiet breaths after someone finishes speaking before you answer, and reread messages once to add a courteous opening.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: Your thinking builds step by step on verified facts, translating complex ideas into tangible, everyday examples.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Once your mind is set on a method, shifting angles feels uncomfortable, and rushed on-the-spot demands can stall you.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Ask for thirty minutes to review written materials before responding to a new proposal, and prepare three practical test questions.

song_tu.diem_sang: You connect disparate facts effortlessly, adapt your vocabulary to any audience, and keep dialogue lively and curious.
song_tu.nen_de_y: Jumping across too many tabs at once can fragment deep reading, and wordplay debates can sidetrack the main deliverable.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Close extra browser tabs each morning to focus on one document at a time, and end long meetings with three written action bullets.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You listen with emotional memory, recall subtle personal context others shared months ago, and phrase feedback with care.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Reasoning can sway with the mood in the room, and when slighted you may retreat into silent assumptions rather than asking.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: Separate objective facts from personal feelings in two columns before making work decisions, and ask directly when a tone feels off.

su_tu.diem_sang: You speak with vivid warmth, frame ideas into memorable stories, and rally a team around a clear, confident vision.
su_tu.nen_de_y: You may dramatize details for effect or tie your pride so closely to an opinion that counterarguments feel personal.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Invite two dissenting viewpoints to speak first in team discussions before you summarize and state your conclusion.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You sort information cleanly, spot workflow gaps early, and write step-by-step instructions that anyone can follow.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: Nitpicking minor wording flaws can slow group momentum, and your mind often runs unfinished checklists late into the evening.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Spend five minutes at the start of a task defining which two elements require strict precision and where good enough suffices.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You articulate both sides of an argument fairly, choose diplomatic phrasing, and defuse tense negotiations with grace.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: Weighing every perspective can make your conclusions sound noncommittal, leaving colleagues unsure which option you back.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: After outlining pros and cons, close every memo with one explicit recommendation and the top practical reason behind it.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You read unspoken motives beneath polite talk, ask investigative questions that reach root causes, and guard confidential facts.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: Fixating on a single suspicion or delivering razor-sharp critiques during disagreements can put others on the defensive.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Frame tough findings as forward-looking repair questions rather than accusations, and set a time cap on investigative rabbit holes.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You synthesize big-picture patterns across disciplines quickly and share candid, inspiring perspectives that widen the conversation.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: Fine print and administrative clauses easily bore you, and unfiltered candor can land harder than you intend.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Run a five-point detail checklist before signing or sending any formal document, and acknowledge effort before delivering blunt feedback.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You structure thoughts around feasibility, timelines, and clear accountability, turning abstract goals into executable plans.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: A dry, rule-heavy tone can discourage early brainstorming, and untested approaches may trigger immediate skepticism.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: When presented with an unfamiliar idea, ask what a low-risk two-week trial would require before listing reasons it might fail.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You think independently outside convention, grasp systems architecture quickly, and evaluate arguments on logic rather than hierarchy.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: You can hold onto an intellectual framework stubbornly or skip intermediate steps so listeners lose your train of thought.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Pair new system proposals with a one-page flowchart and ask teammates which everyday step will change for them.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You absorb meaning through tone, metaphor, and subtle atmosphere, offering compassionate listening and creative synthesis.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: Heavy information noise can blur dates and details, and impressionistic phrasing can leave practical expectations unclear.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Follow up every verbal agreement with a brief message confirming exact dates, numbers, and next steps.

kim_tinh.vai_tro: values, aesthetic taste, and how affection and rapport are shared

bach_duong.diem_sang: You express affection and appreciation with fresh candor, take the first step warmly, and move past minor friction quickly.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: Impulse purchases can spike on a whim, and everyday relational routines can feel dull once the initial spark settles.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Wait forty-eight hours before buying non-essential items, and plan active shared outings to keep close bonds energized.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: You cultivate lasting comfort, appreciate fine craftsmanship and good meals, and offer steady, loyal affection over time.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Possessiveness or resistance to changing relationship routines can surface, along with comfort spending when tired.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Automate savings transfers at the start of each month, and voice appreciation aloud alongside tangible gifts.

song_tu.diem_sang: You build rapport through wit, curiosity, and engaging conversation, keeping friendships and partnerships light on their feet.
song_tu.nen_de_y: Keeping interactions playful can become a way to sidestep vulnerable emotional talks or deeper commitments.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Set aside one phone-free evening each week for an unhurried, heartfelt conversation, and track social spending in a simple budget.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You show care through thoughtful domestic warmth, remembering what makes loved ones feel safe and genuinely looked after.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: When insecure you may sulk indirectly or over-give silently and then feel resentful when the gesture is not mirrored.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: State one specific way you would like to be cared for each week, and maintain a personal reserve fund for peace of mind.

su_tu.diem_sang: You love generously, bring flair and celebration into shared life, and take pride in cheering on the people you cherish.
su_tu.nen_de_y: Overspending to make a grand impression or feeling deflated when thoughtful gestures go unpraised can create strain.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Cap monthly gift and entertainment budgets in advance, and ask loved ones how they prefer to receive appreciation.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You express devotion through quiet, practical helpfulness, thoughtful attention to detail, and sensible stewardship of money.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: Offering unsolicited fixes as a form of care can feel critical to a partner and crowd out spontaneous warmth.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Name three things you appreciate about someone before suggesting an improvement, and budget a small sum for pure leisure.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You bring natural grace, fair-minded reciprocity, and refined aesthetic balance into partnerships and social spaces.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: Saying yes just to preserve surface harmony can breed quiet exhaustion, and simple choices can stall in indecision.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Offer two concrete options you genuinely enjoy when planning shared time, and review style or decor purchases against a monthly list.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You bond with deep loyalty, stand firm through real hardship, and handle shared financial resources with sharp discernment.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: All-or-nothing emotional tests, jealousy, or locking feelings away after a disappointment can strain trust.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Voice relationship concerns calmly as soon as they arise rather than testing the other person in silence, and keep joint finances transparent.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You bring open-hearted humor, respect for personal freedom, and a love of shared travel and learning into relationships.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: Restlessness when domestic duties pile up or optimistic overspending on trips and courses can catch up with you.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Keep a dedicated travel and learning sinking fund, and honor small daily promises so loved ones trust your consistency.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You demonstrate affection through enduring reliability, kept promises, and thoughtful long-range financial planning.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: Holding back tender words or treating relationship milestones like performance reviews can make you seem reserved.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Send one warm, unhurried note during the workday with no agenda attached, and protect leisure hours free of productivity goals.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You value intellectual friendship, unconventional individuality, and giving partners ample breathing room to be themselves.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: Responding to a partner's emotional vulnerability with cool logic can leave them feeling held at arm's length.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Offer quiet physical presence and empathetic listening first when someone close is upset before suggesting practical solutions.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You offer gentle compassion, poetic romance, and forgiving kindness that helps people feel accepted without judgment.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: Looking past red flags out of sympathy or lending money without clear boundaries can drain your resources.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Set a fixed monthly ceiling for financial help or favors, and ground relationship trust in consistent actions rather than promises.

hoa_tinh.vai_tro: action drive, boundary assertion, and stamina under pressure

bach_duong.diem_sang: You launch into action decisively, tackle high-pressure starters head-on, and clear immediate obstacles without hesitation.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: Flashes of impatience when slowed down and sprinting hard early only to lose steam on maintenance tasks can trip you up.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Break long projects into seven-day sprints with clear finish lines, and use regular physical exercise to release nervous tension.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: Once in motion you work with remarkable stamina, seeing demanding practical builds through to completion without cutting corners.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Getting started on unfamiliar tasks takes extra inertia, and grievances held too long can erupt in immovable stubbornness.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Kick off each morning with one fifteen-minute tangible task to build momentum, and address minor frustrations the week they happen.

song_tu.diem_sang: You coordinate multiple fast-moving tasks smoothly, pivot tactics on the fly, and defend your position with quick verbal agility.
song_tu.nen_de_y: Scattering effort across too many side projects dilutes impact, and irritation can spill out as sharp sarcasm.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Commit to finishing two priority tasks each morning before opening new threads, and draft heated replies offline before sending.

cu_giai.diem_sang: You act with fierce protective resolve when defending family, close teammates, or a safe working environment.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Asserting boundaries sideways through moodiness or letting emotional weather dictate daily work output can slow you down.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: State personal boundaries in one calm, direct sentence without apology, and keep a steady physical routine regardless of mood.

su_tu.diem_sang: You bring bold, wholehearted energy to leadership challenges, inspiring confidence and taking visible ownership of hard goals.
su_tu.nen_de_y: Wounded pride can trigger disproportionate pushback, and quiet behind-the-scenes upkeep can feel unrewarding.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Ask yourself in heated moments whether you are defending the work outcome or your ego, and take pride in thorough preparation.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You channel drive into precise craftsmanship, troubleshooting bottlenecks methodically and improving everyday systems.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: Stress can tighten into perfectionist micromanagement, redoing others' work while feeling silently overburdened.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Define clear acceptance criteria when delegating tasks so you can step back, and stretch tense shoulders during afternoon breaks.

thien_binh.diem_sang: You act through collaborative strategy, rallying allies and stepping up firmly when fairness or shared agreements are breached.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: Polling everyone's opinion before acting or delaying necessary confrontation to keep the peace can stall execution.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Set a twenty-four-hour decision window for independent tasks, and address disagreements early while the stakes are still small.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You possess unwavering focus under crisis, conserving energy for the decisive move and seeing deep reforms through.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: Power struggles can turn uncompromising, and old slights may simmer below the surface long after an issue is settled.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Channel intense drive into endurance training or deep technical research, and consciously close the book once a dispute is resolved.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You surge with enthusiasm when pursuing a meaningful quest, breaking trail into new territory with infectious optimism.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: Routine follow-through after the launch phase can lag, and debates over principles can get overly fiery.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Partner with a detail-oriented colleague to anchor project completion, and close one open loop before starting any new venture.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You pace your energy like a seasoned mountaineer, executing complex long-term plans with cool composure under pressure.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: Driving yourself and others on relentless efficiency metrics can override early signs of physical fatigue.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Block recovery time on your calendar with the same discipline as deadlines, and celebrate incremental milestones along the climb.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You tackle problems through inventive experimentation, challenging outdated rules and mobilizing collective reforms.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: Arbitrary authority can provoke sudden contrarian pushback or abrupt withdrawal from an ongoing workflow.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Negotiate clear autonomy over your methods at the start of a project, and give teammates advance notice before changing a shared process.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You move with intuitive timing, navigating around rigid obstacles creatively and pouring heart into service or artistic work.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: Unclear priorities can lead to drifting procrastination or exhaustion from absorbing everyone else's urgent requests.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Complete one measurable priority task before noon each day, and practice declining requests that exceed your weekly capacity.

moc_tinh.vai_tro: growth horizon, guiding philosophy, and constructive generosity

bach_duong.diem_sang: You expand opportunities fastest when pioneering fresh ventures, inspiring confidence through decisive action and self-reliant courage.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: Early enthusiasm can cause you to underestimate logistical groundwork or launch too many fronts at once before securing support.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Before greenlighting a major initiative, define three progress checkpoints and partner with an operations-minded colleague.

kim_nguu.diem_sang: Your growth vision is rooted in tangible value: compounding financial resources, durable craftsmanship, and steady long-term yields.
kim_nguu.nen_de_y: Over-prioritizing familiar comfort and guaranteed returns can make you pass up timely innovations that require stepping onto new ground.
kim_nguu.viec_ung_dung: Allocate a fixed quarterly budget or time block to test one emerging tool or invest in a long-horizon skill upgrade.

song_tu.diem_sang: You thrive through cross-disciplinary curiosity, weaving diverse streams of information together and translating complex ideas into accessible stories.
song_tu.nen_de_y: Chasing too many fascinating topics simultaneously can dilute your expertise, leaving wide reading unfinished as concrete deliverables.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Pick one anchor theme each quarter to synthesize into a structured guide or teach back to peers so your knowledge crystallizes.

cu_giai.diem_sang: Your generosity shines through nurturing close communities, creating psychologically safe workplaces, and building enduring interpersonal trust.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Well-meant protection can tip into over-sheltering others, fostering dependency or draining your own reserves with emotional caretaking.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: Support people by equipping them with tools and coaching their next step rather than taking over the entire burden yourself.

su_tu.diem_sang: You radiate optimism through warm-hearted leadership, championing the talents of people around you and staging ambitious creative showcases.
su_tu.nen_de_y: A desire for grand scale or visible prestige can tempt you to overextend budgets or promise more than the team can sustainably deliver.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Focus resources on initiatives that build lasting shared value, and invite candid cost-and-capacity feedback before scaling up.

xu_nu.diem_sang: You unlock significant growth by refining operational standards, elevating service quality, and earning trust through meticulous craft.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: Zooming in too tightly on minor defects can narrow your strategic horizon, making you hesitate before bold moves that are not yet flawless.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: When evaluating a new proposal, write a full page on its upside potential before listing the technical risks that need mitigation.

thien_binh.diem_sang: Your horizons widen through equitable partnerships, diplomatic conflict resolution, and a natural sense of proportion that draws allies together.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: Trying to keep every stakeholder equally pleased can delay strategic decisions that require taking a firm, unmistakable stand.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Draft explicit partnership criteria in writing up front so collaboration rests on transparent principles rather than polite accommodation.

bo_cap.diem_sang: You grow most powerfully when diving into specialized research, navigating high-stakes turnarounds, or pooling resources for root-cause reform.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: A habit of guarding information too closely or assuming hidden motives can limit the open trust needed for broader alliances.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Practice graduated transparency with vetted partners and apply your investigative depth to untangling shared bottlenecks.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: You possess a far-reaching horizon, spotting cultural or educational trends early and sustaining an infectious love of lifelong exploration.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: Excitement over the grand thesis can leave daily execution under-scaffolded or lead to commitments that exceed your calendar.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Anchor every big-picture vision to a monthly execution roadmap with concrete, measurable deliverables.

ma_ket.diem_sang: You scale through patient institutional building, earning professional credibility step by step and turning real-world constraints into leverage.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: Excessive caution or reliance only on proven precedents can make you slow to embrace unconventional breakthroughs.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Alongside your core conservative plan, open one bounded pilot track with capped downside to test fresh approaches.

bao_binh.diem_sang: You open new frontiers through independent systems thinking, connecting diverse civic or professional networks around forward-looking reforms.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: Focusing heavily on macro-level frameworks can occasionally leave the immediate emotional realities of individuals around you under-attended.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Validate every large-scale reform proposal with a small pilot that directly serves a concrete group of everyday users.

song_ngu.diem_sang: You bring deep compassion, artistic imagination, and quiet receptivity that uplifts people who feel unheard or overwhelmed.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: Porous boundaries can pull you into impractical appeals or scatter your time across too many rescue efforts at once.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Dedicate a fixed weekly time slot and budget for creative or charitable work so your generosity stays sustainable and grounded.

tho_tinh.vai_tro: structural discipline, realistic limits, and long-term craft

bach_duong.diem_sang: Your core maturation lies in learning self-paced initiative, turning raw starting energy into disciplined, self-directed endurance.
bach_duong.nen_de_y: You may swing between hesitating at the starting line out of self-doubt and pushing impatiently before the groundwork is ready.
bach_duong.viec_ung_dung: Build independent pacing through thirty-day work sprints, tracking incremental progress rather than demanding instant victories.

song_tu.nen_de_y: Feeling talked over or doubting your intellectual fluency in fast-moving rooms can trigger quiet self-criticism.
song_tu.viec_ung_dung: Write out your core insights in structured essays or guides, and tutor learners who feel intimidated by complex subjects.

cu_giai.diem_sang: Tender sensitivity around belonging and family roots gives you a rare ability to build safe, welcoming spaces for people who feel unanchored.
cu_giai.nen_de_y: Old family misunderstandings can ache when your quiet caretaking goes unreciprocated or unnoticed.
cu_giai.viec_ung_dung: Practice extending the same nurturing care to yourself that you give loved ones, while building community spaces with clear, respectful boundaries.

su_tu.diem_sang: Working through self-consciousness around creative visibility makes you an encouraging mentor capable of drawing out shy talent in others.
su_tu.nen_de_y: Unacknowledged creative effort can sting deeply, or make you hesitate to share playful work unless it looks impressive.
su_tu.viec_ung_dung: Create for the intrinsic joy of the craft itself, and make a habit of spotlighting emerging contributors in your circle.

xu_nu.diem_sang: Understanding the exhaustion of perfectionism helps you design humane, practical workflows and realistic wellness routines for overburdened people.
xu_nu.nen_de_y: When setbacks occur, an inner critic can fixate on tiny flaws or whisper that your contribution is never quite useful enough.
xu_nu.viec_ung_dung: Acknowledge tasks that are solidly complete at eighty percent, and share your practical organizing skills to lighten others' daily load.

thien_binh.diem_sang: Hard-earned lessons in partnership dynamics give you wise, balanced insight when mediating conflict or coaching healthy relational boundaries.
thien_binh.nen_de_y: Fear of relational rupture can lead you to swallow disagreements for too long until quiet resentment builds.
thien_binh.viec_ung_dung: Voice minor differences early with calm respect, modeling how honest candor actually strengthens long-term harmony.

bo_cap.diem_sang: Walking through deep trust reckonings or loss equips you to stand beside people navigating major life transitions without flinching.
bo_cap.nen_de_y: Tender sensitivity around betrayal can prompt you to erect overly steep loyalty tests before letting anyone close.
bo_cap.viec_ung_dung: Apply your psychological depth to confidential mentoring, research, or crisis guidance anchored in clear ethical boundaries.

nhan_ma.diem_sang: Questioning inherited dogmas to find lived meaning makes you an open-minded teacher who helps others build their own authentic compass.
nhan_ma.nen_de_y: Periods of philosophical doubt or feeling out of step with mainstream beliefs can occasionally feel isolating.
nhan_ma.viec_ung_dung: Share lessons drawn from real field experience rather than abstract doctrine, inviting learners to test ideas for themselves.

ma_ket.diem_sang: Knowing the weight of relentless achievement pressure turns you into a seasoned mentor who balances high standards with humane realism.
ma_ket.nen_de_y: Carrying an internal judge that measures worth solely by rank or output can make ordinary rest feel undeserved.
ma_ket.viec_ung_dung: Define success by sustainable long-term craft, and coach juniors on how to hit meaningful milestones without burning out.

bao_binh.diem_sang: Having felt like an outsider inside conventional groups gives you a gift for weaving diverse, unconventional thinkers into an inclusive network.
bao_binh.nen_de_y: Ambivalence between wanting community belonging and guarding your independence can keep you hovering at the edge of the room.
bao_binh.viec_ung_dung: Contribute your distinctive systems perspective directly to group problem-solving and make sure quieter voices at the table are heard.

song_ngu.diem_sang: Deep sensitivity to collective sorrow gives you a gentle healing presence through music, contemplative listening, and unforced compassion.
song_ngu.nen_de_y: Without firm daily anchors, absorbing the confusion or distress of your surroundings can leave you emotionally depleted.
song_ngu.viec_ung_dung: Return to simple physical grounding and breath after supporting others so your compassion stays clear, steady, and replenished.

pham_gia_ptolemy.nguon_tham_chieu: Classical essential dignities table synthesized from Claudius Ptolemy, Tetrabiblos, Book I, Chapters 17-19 (Houses of the Planets and Exaltations of the seven classical bodies).

vuong_dia.giai_thich: The planet occupies its own classical sign in Ptolemy's scheme: its function expresses directly, steadily, and on its own terms.

vuong_ton.giai_thich: The planet occupies its classical sign of honor in Ptolemy's table: its faculties are heightened and sharp when channeled with discipline.

vuong_dia_kiem_vuong_ton.giai_thich: Mercury in Virgo holds both domicile rulership and exaltation in Ptolemy's table: analytical precision, classification, and practical craft operate at peak clarity.

tu_dia.giai_thich: The planet occupies the sign opposite its classical domicile: its function works through deliberate adaptation rather than automatic habit.

suy_dia.giai_thich: The planet occupies the sign opposite its classical exaltation: its expression matures through lived calibration and patient boundary-setting.

tu_dia_kiem_suy_dia.giai_thich: Mercury in Pisces sits opposite Virgo in Ptolemy's scheme: perception flows through imagery and empathy rather than linear sorting, benefiting from written anchors.
